title: BigTrap2 as a creator-bar classifier, not a magnetic zone

why_this_and_not_far_zones.audit: OPEN_FAR_ZONE_FAMILY does not fire: tail contrast ci95_lower is not > 0. The tail itself is also present on non-trap bars with the same (d,w,side). The valid label is OPEN_BAR_CLASSIFIER.
why_this_and_not_far_zones.object: the creator bar and the geometry it licenses, not the kernel zone as a magnet

purpose.statement: If BigTrap2 is a detector of a bar regime, F2.9 asks which cheaper description recovers the race, whether the kernel zone still adds a residual, and whether the mark persists to neighboring bars. That residual, if any, is the only honest input to a later aVol combination.

kernel_facts_used_as_priors_not_as_resul.trapped_buyers: aggressive ask rows ABOVE close, in the upper wick_zone_pct of the bar, ratio>=3, vol>=30
kernel_facts_used_as_priors_not_as_resul.trapped_sellers: aggressive bid rows BELOW close, in the lower wick_zone_pct of the bar
kernel_facts_used_as_priors_not_as_resul.simple_rules_are_ohlc_volume_only: Do not put footprint imbalance into the simple rules. That would restate the kernel. Footprint is a separate ladder rung.

canonical_probe.side_rule: upper_wick >= lower_wick => bull probe above close; else bear probe below close
canonical_probe.why: Mode of F2.7/F2.8 distance is 2; median width is 1. The probe must be computable on EVERY bar, including non-creators. Do not reuse the kernel zone interval as the only probe: that cannot be placed on non-creators without matching.

A_bar_portrait.question: What observable marks a creator bar before any race is computed?
A_bar_portrait.contrast: creator vs non-creator, session-equal-weight mean difference, HAC

B_canonical_probe_ladder.question: On the same P_mode probe, who has the race?

rungs_in_order.selects: bars that actually created a BigTrap2 zone
non-creator bars matched to a K0 bar on session, range quintile, close_loc quintile, volume quintile; nearest in time

B_canonical_probe_ladder.note: S0 wick 30% and range>=3 are read from the kernel wick filter and from d=2+width=1, not from F2.9 peeking.
B_canonical_probe_ladder.estimand: session-equal-weight mean of r_i on P_mode, zeros included, HAC
B_canonical_probe_ladder.required_contrast: K0 minus N0 paired by session; K0 minus S1 paired by session

C_zone_residual.question: After the bar is fixed, does the kernel zone still beat P_mode on that same bar?
C_zone_residual.contrast: paired per bar, then session mean, HAC
C_zone_residual.interpretation: If this contrast is compatible with zero, the zone geometry is not incremental given the bar. If it is positive, a residual zone object still exists and can later meet aVol.

D_persistence.question: Is the mark instantaneous or a short regime?
D_persistence.interpretation: If +1/+2 keep the race, the product is a regime window. If only 0 has it, the product is a single-bar stamp.

E_almost_kernel.question: How much of K0 is just footprint imbalance in the wick, before min_trap_volume?
E_almost_kernel.rung: F0 = bars that would emit TRAP (export) even if vol < min_trap_volume
E_almost_kernel.interpretation: If F0≈K0, the trap-volume floor is cosmetic. If S1<<F0≈K0, the object is footprint, not OHLC. If K0>F0, multi-row trap geometry still adds something.

decision_rules.OPEN_SIMPLE_BAR_RULE: S1 has ci95_lower>0 and (K0-S1) paired contrast is compatible with zero, with support gates
decision_rules.OPEN_FOOTPRINT_OBJECT: F0 has ci95_lower>0 and S1 is compatible with zero or (F0-S1) ci95_lower>0 while (K0-F0) is compatible with zero
decision_rules.OPEN_ZONE_RESIDUAL: family C paired contrast ci95_lower>0 with support
decision_rules.OPEN_SINGLE_BAR_STAMP: K0 or S1 positive and both +1 and +2 compatible with zero
decision_rules.KEEP_BT2_AS_DETECTOR: (K0-S1) ci95_lower>0 and (K0-N0) ci95_lower>0: the kernel still selects better than the simple rule and the matched non-creator
decision_rules.CLOSE_BAR_OBJECT: no rung has a positive race after gates
decision_rules.forbidden_reinterpretation: Do not relabel OPEN_ZONE_RESIDUAL as far-zone magnetism. Do not open Z2.

what_this_unlocks.if_OPEN_SIMPLE_BAR_RULE: later aVol can condition on a cheap OHLC stamp, not on BigTrap2 zones
what_this_unlocks.if_OPEN_FOOTPRINT_OBJECT: the combinable object is imbalance-in-wick, which is closer to aVol's language
what_this_unlocks.if_OPEN_ZONE_RESIDUAL: only then is a BigTrap2 x aVol interaction even eligible
what_this_unlocks.if_OPEN_REGIME_WINDOW: timing product: a short window after the stamp, still target-free
what_this_unlocks.if_KEEP_BT2_AS_DETECTOR: keep the kernel as the selector; do not replace it with S1
